title: Aureline M5 starter-parameter-row component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the starter-parameter-row family binds inside the frozen M5 scaffold-component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-scaffold-component-matrix.schema.json). A starter parameter row names where a parameter value comes from and whether its action is applied immediately or deferred so a row never leaves the parameter source layer or the immediate-versus-deferred boundary implicit. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-templates is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
